review_scope: Adversarial review of the embodied integration definitions, formal joins, countermodels, quarantine boundary, evaluation disposition, and the enforcement machinery added in response.

findings.resolution: Candidate obtainment is definitionally tied to EmbodiedRecurrentStructure and locked by the EC-D6 equivalence theorem.
Free coordination, registration, affection, and representational-efficacy predicates were replaced by exact membership, endpoint, feed, and equality joins.
Each formalized anti-entailment now negates the canonical target structure at the declared shared indices; proxy false predicates were removed.
Body is a state-indexed Relation without a separate identity criterion; Entity supplies Boundary, Interior, Persistence, and identity.
Both recurrent Transformation families and the perspective-selection join are indexed through the same Body, Entity, Direction, and feeding relation.
Action and complete Control plus Attribution and Designation reverse anti-entailments are binding prose explicitly marked outside the current reduct instead of receiving proxy countermodels.
Evaluation status and human promotion disposition are recorded independently, preserving incomplete model evaluation without treating it as a release veto or pass.
Schema-v2 manifests, exact Lean promotion contracts, a semantic-field ledger, and exact-source review hashes now turn the relevant review obligations into CI failures.
